caption:
Before a customer calls your salon, clinic or restaurant, they look you up on their phone. 📱

If all they find is an old Facebook post, they usually move on to the next business.

A simple website gives them what they're looking for:
✅ Your services and prices
✅ Opening hours and location on Google Maps
✅ A WhatsApp button so they can message you in one tap
✅ A proper first impression
